Adventurer Ranks from weakest to strongest :

Bronze -> Steel -> Silver -> Gold -> Platinum -> Mithril -> Orichalcum -> Adamantium

Rune/Potion/Spell Ranks : Lesser, common , greater, grand, legendary.

Sub-ranks of runes and other items:  Lowest, Low, intermediate, high, and highest.

Coins :

10 small copper coins = 1 large copper coin

10 large copper coins = 1 small silver coin

10 small silver coins = 1 large silver coin

10 large silver coins = 1 small gold coin

10 small gold coins = 1 large gold coin

10 large gold coins = 1 royal gold coin
